task.text: A candle is lit and then put inside of a giant wiffle ball. That wiffle ball is put inside of an even bigger wiffle ball, which in turn is put inside an even bigger wiffle ball. The biggest wiffle ball is forcibly held entirely under water. What likely happens in the next hour?
